thread:
emma (Support): FYI ticket #T-10294 — customer can't complete the free trial because our 'card on file' flow hits an issuer challenge loop. They get stuck on the 3DS step and the UI never returns status.

emma (Support): Stripe webhooks show repeated 'payment_intent.requires_action' -> customer sees challenge iframe -> times out -> we get another 'authentication_required' event. Customer tried Chrome and Safari, same result.

emma (Support): Pasting redacted payment_intent from logs:
```json
{
  "id": "pi_1Jxxx",
  "status": "requires_action",
  "next_action": {
    "type": "use_stripe_sdk",
    "redirect_to_url": {
      "url": "https://hooks.stripe.com/3ds-challenge/xyz"
    }
  }
}
```

diego (Payments Eng): Thanks, emma. Can you confirm card brand and customer country? Also any CSP / iframe blockers on the customer's site? If they're using an embedded checkout in an iframe that blocks top-level navigation, the challenge can fail.

emma (Support): Customer says card brand = Visa, billing country = IE. They are using our native hosted form (not embedded). No known extensions. Tried incognito.

sam (SRE): Noted. I saw a related spike in webhook retries around 2024-06-12 14:23 UTC from payments-bot. payments-bot: delivery 429 on our auth webhook for that payment_intent?

payments-bot: webhook delivery log -> status: 200 for /internal/payments/webhook; stripe_event_id: evt_3Kyyy; attempts: 3; last_response_time_ms: 1200. No obvious errors returned.

diego (Payments Eng): Hm. Two possibilities: issuer continuously re-challenges (issuer UI redirect loop), or the customer is hitting our client-side timeout and we re-create the PI causing duplicate flows. What's our client timeout for challenge?

sam (SRE): Frontend challenge timeout is 45s before we show the generic error. We do have a guard that will cancel the attempt after 60s and surface a 'challenge_timeout' code back to the server. I don't see cancel events for this PI though.

diego (Payments Eng): Ok. Repro steps request for payments team:
1) Create a trial intent with card that triggers SCA (EU BIN)
2) Complete 3DS challenge but simulate issuer returning redirect to same challenge URL repeatedly (issuer loop)
3) Observe our UI behavior + webhook sequence

emma (Support): Customer wants the trial today. Can we issue trial credits manually while we investigate?

diego (Payments Eng): Short-term: yes. Support can grant credits via admin CLI: `admin_tools grant_trial --customer-id C_12345 --reason "3DS blocker T-10294"` — that will bypass payment requirement. Note: record in ticket and require sign-off from kyla.

kyla (Account Exec): Approved. Emma, please grant and confirm with customer, also capture their card fingerprint for root-cause analysis.

emma (Support): Grant done, customer confirmed they see trial access. I added ticket note and included PI id and card fingerprint.

diego (Payments Eng): For mitigation we should add better telemetry: record challenge round-trip times, number of redirects in challenge, and issuer response codes. I'll add a short PR to log `next_action.redirect_to_url` length and unexpected redirect loops.

diego (Payments Eng): Proposed long-term fix: if issuer performs >3 identical redirects within 30s, surface a clear error to user suggesting "Try another payment method or contact bank" and escalate to manual grant flow.

sam (SRE): Also want to add a dashboard for 'challenge loop' rate and a runbook link. I'll create an alerts rule if >0.5% of PIs per hour hit >3 redirects.

emma (Support): Closing loop with customer. Will monitor for similar tickets and collect any new PIs. Leaving this thread open for payments team follow-up PRs.

diego (Payments Eng): I'll attach the PR and a short changelog to the ticket when ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
